website.notes: Legal entity Kayla Mayotech LLP. Tagline 'Shaping the Future, with Apps & Ai'. Office: HiLITE Business Park, 5th Floor, Room No 2515, Calicut (Kozhikode), Kerala 673014; registered address: Suite 10, Kanshub, Wandoor, Malappuram 679328. Founder & CEO: Jishnu VR (site claims '40+ Projects Delivered', '25+ Team Members'). Services: Flutter cross-platform app dev, web (React, Next.js, Flutter Web), desktop, UI/UX, digital marketing, maintenance & support. Featured portfolio (fetched): Tokify and Loyal Meet (real-time audio/video calling), HYZR (Kochi ride-hailing with real-time tracking and secure payments, beta), ByonCare (telemedicine video calls), Vijayan Vaidyar's Clinic (hospital mgmt), Poultry Pilot, E Tern (kids learning), Nadec (B2B milk e-commerce), Payweekly (e-commerce), Syut, TopoMate, Gala, DD Card, Hoavy, Fan App, Beach (in dev). Tech stack page lists: React, Flutter, Node.js, Firebase, MongoDB, Next.js, CSS, Android, iOS, GitHub, Shopify, WordPress, Figma, Supabase - no NestJS, PostgreSQL, Docker, Redis, Django or Python shown publicly. Partner/integration logos displayed: PhonePe, Google Maps, Razorpay, Cashfree, AWS, Stripe, Agora, Firebase, MSG91. Contact: enquiries@kaylamayotech.com, +91 7736991991. Site footer copyright 2025.

reviews.notes: No Glassdoor or Ambitionbox employee-review profile found (ambitionbox.com/reviews/kayla-mayotech-reviews returns 404; no Glassdoor result surfaced). Third-party place listing for the Wandoor/Malappuram office (same phone +91 8848601460, website kaylamayotech.in) shows 4.8/5 from 26 reviews; fetched review text is overwhelmingly positive CLIENT testimonials (Apr-Jun 2024, on-time delivery, technical skill, communication) plus one 1-star client complaint dated 2025-04-21 alleging an 83K payment for undelivered work. Reviews are client-side, not employee-side, so culture/retention signal is effectively unverified. Website separately self-reports '5.0 from 40+ reviews'.

media.notes: No press coverage or news articles found for Kayla Mayotech (searches for news/funding/expansion returned only job boards and app directories). Closest third-party signal: app analytics page for 'Ponkudam: Live Lottery Result', Google Play publisher listed as KAYLA MAYOTECH LLP (package com.kayla.lotteryresult, developer Jishnu V R / KAYLA LINK): 1M+ lifetime installs, 4.6 stars from ~18k ratings, ~500k downloads/month, India Finance-free chart rank ~#157, first released 20 Apr 2019, updated Sep 2026 - evidence the entity ships and operates consumer apps at real scale, though this product predates the current portfolio page.
